description: Establishment of a Training Centre on Renewable Energy by the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the increasing demand for skilled training in the renewable energy sector in Sri Lanka, a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed between the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute and the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority on 2025-02-10 to implement a project to construct a new training centre on renewable energy. The said new training centre has been planned to be constructed on a land in extent of 3.11 hectares in the Mayurapura Division of the Walawa Zone of the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka, as an affiliated branch of the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute. Since the new training centre is proposed to be established in close proximity to the Kiriibbanwewa Floating Solar Power Plant and the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority's Hambantota Training Centre, students will have the opportunity to receive direct practical training as well.  The key objective of the project is to jointly implement a Renewable Energy Training Hub with the integration of the proposed new training centre and other relevant institutions. It is expected that the said training hub will provide subject knowledge and practical training covering energy efficiency, electronic and mechanical engineering knowledge as well as renewable energy fields such as solar, wind, hydropower and biomass energy, thereby creating skilled professional technicians.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to implement the project for the construction of the said training centre on renewable energy using local funds at an estimated cost of               Rs.398 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
